evidence: Version 3 (image 7) best fulfills the '夜漆翠羽' concept: a single seamless polished lacquer panel in deep jade with a broad soft frontal glow descending from the top band and genuine lacquer-layer sheen at the panel edges; the bottle is centered, restrained in scale (roughly mid-frame mass with base well inside the安全 bounds), and sits with a soft convincing contact shadow rather than floating; all typography is confined to the top narrow band in a coherent serif hierarchy with the fine gold rule suspended beneath it, echoing the gold plaque. Compared with version 1's flat painted-plank seams and sans-serif type, version 2's stray vertical seams cutting through the headline band and weak grounding, version 4's near-identical but slightly looser bottle-to-band balance with a faintly muddier sheen, and version 5's hard horizontal panel junction behind the bottle that reads as a raised support edge with the packshot floating in front of it, version 3 is the cleanest finished set with the most controlled material and lighting.
remaining_problems: Contact shadow under the bottle is very subtle; the packshot still reads slightly adhered to the lacquer rather than weighted onto it.
The top light bloom slightly washes the lacquer depth near the headline band, softening the intended deep-jade saturation.
Gold rule and serif type are cream-dark rather than the richer gold accent of the palette; the gold note survives only on the bottle plaque.
